title: Re-evaluating Heart Rate Variability Biomarkers for Glucose Sensing: The Impact of Age Normalisation and Subject-Independent Validation
abstract: arXiv:2508.11682v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Heart rate variability (HRV) from electrocardiogram (ECG) signals may indicate glycemic status, but prior studies often combine distinct glucose targets and use validation strategies vulnerable to data leakage. Since HRV declines with age, aging may be confounded with diabetes-related autonomic dysfunction. We tested whether age-dependent HRV normalisation improves glycemic estimation. We analysed ECG features from 43 male patients with type 2 diabetes. Outcomes were glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c; n=29) and fasting blood glucose (FBG; n=38). We used leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, with feature selection and standardisation within each training fold. We compared 20 machine-learning algorithms, six age-adjustment methods, and 20 normalisation parameter combinations. Validation included 500 permutations and bootstrap confidence intervals. Extra Trees regression performed best: R2=0.222 (r=0.476, p=0.009) for HbA1c and R2=0.08

translated_title: 重新评估心率变异性生物标志物用于血糖感知：年龄标准化与受试者独立验证的影响
translated_abstract: 来自心电图（ECG）信号的心率变异性（HRV）可能反映血糖状态，但以往的研究常常将不同的血糖指标混合在一起，并使用容易发生数据泄漏的验证策略。由于HRV随年龄增长而下降，衰老可能与糖尿病相关的自主神经功能障碍相混淆。我们检验了基于年龄的HRV标准化是否能改善血糖估计。我们分析了43名男性2型糖尿病患者的ECG特征。结局指标为糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c；n=29）和空腹血糖（FBG；n=38）。我们采用留一受试者交叉验证，并在每个训练折内进行特征选择和标准化。我们比较了20种机器学习算法、6种年龄调整方法和20种标准化参数组合。验证包括500次置换检验和自助法置信区间。Extra Trees回归表现最佳：HbA1c的R²=0.222（r=0.476，p=0.009），FBG的R²=0.08（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过留一受试者交叉验证和基于年龄的HRV标准化方法，严格重新评估了心率变异性作为无创血糖感知生物标志物的有效性，发现其预测能力有限（HbA1c的R²仅为0.222）。
en_tdlr: This study rigorously re-evaluates HRV as a biomarker for non-invasive glucose sensing using subject-independent validation and age normalisation, revealing only limited predictive performance for glycemic estimation (HbA1c R²=0.222).
